imageQa.note: Intentional image-free layouts; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product imagery. The leather-jacket guide uses accurate category text links only.

searchConsole.signal: Four homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.5, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster
searchConsole.decision: The sample is too small and queryless to support a Data-led page. Today's portfolio therefore uses one authority expansion and two distinct explorations while strengthening crawl paths from established guides.
searchConsole.ignored: The four homepage impressions, the HTTP homepage variant and aggregate average position were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or a topical pivot.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed, sponsored/nofollow category text recommendations appear only on the leather-jacket guide. The home-project and jet-lag guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy home-improvement change-order and payment-control file that reconciles the baseline contract, field condition, scope delta, price, credits, schedule, approval, payment and closeout evidence.
authority.cluster: Home-project and consumer-protection authority, with reciprocal contextual paths from contractor-estimate, appliance-delivery, complaint-resolution and emergency-document guides; outerwear and travel clusters gain reciprocal links as well.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified consumer-education accuracy opportunities were logged for the National Consumer Law Center and Cornell Cooperative Extension housing educators; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three different questions across Life and Style: how to control a construction change, how to buy and maintain a leather jacket, and how to plan sleep, light and arrival safety across time zones. The authority record is noncommercial, the outerwear guide alone serves purchase intent, and the travel plan is a health-adjacent practical explainer; none follows the weak Search Console sample.
